notes: Each ability is themed to the character and SCALES over the round so fights climax past the 1-minute mark. Tune the *_gain / interval numbers to keep fights close.

characters.name: Tralalero Tralala
characters.theme: Shark in Nike sneakers, three-legged sprinter
characters.mechanic: Runs faster every second; faster speed = harder hits.
characters.signature_fx: speed trail behind the ball that grows longer as speed increases

characters.name: Bombardiro Crocodilo
characters.mechanic: Drops bombs from above that explode for area damage; drops more often as the round goes on.
characters.signature_fx: bomb falls from top, explosion flash + expanding shockwave ring on impact

characters.name: Tung Tung Tung Sahur
characters.theme: Wooden drum creature with a baseball bat
characters.mechanic: Spins his bat; the spin gets faster and hits harder the longer the fight lasts.
characters.signature_fx: widening motion-blur arc around the bat as spin speeds up

characters.name: Ballerina Cappuccina
characters.theme: Ballerina with a cappuccino head, pirouettes
characters.mechanic: Pirouettes in place; each spin adds a stacking damage buff that keeps climbing.
characters.signature_fx: spinning ring of coffee/sparkles around her; adds another ring + brightens each buff stack

characters.name: Boneca Ambalabu
characters.mechanic: Rolls random damage each hit with a multiplier that climbs all round.
characters.signature_fx: dice/slot symbols flash above her on each hit; jackpot flash + gold burst on a high roll

characters.name: Cappuccino Assassino
characters.mechanic: Every few hits he lands a caffeinated combo; combos get longer and faster as he 'wakes up' over the round.

characters.name: Brr Brr Patapim
characters.theme: Tree-legged creature rooted to the ground
characters.mechanic: Grows roots/branches that spread across the arena; the more branches, the more contact damage he deals.

characters.name: Chimpanzini Bananini
characters.mechanic: Throws banana peels that make the opponent slip; each slip stacks a lasting speed penalty on the enemy.
characters.signature_fx: enemy visibly spins out and wobbles when they slip on a peel

characters.name: Lirili Larila
characters.mechanic: Slows time in bursts; while active his own hits count double, and the bursts come more often late-game.
characters.signature_fx: whole arena tints blue + motion blur during the time-slow burst

universal_hit_fx.flash: ball flashes white for ~4 frames on impact
universal_hit_fx.squash_stretch: quick squash-and-stretch deform on the hit ball
universal_hit_fx.damage_number: number pops and floats up/fades; bigger & redder for bigger hits
universal_hit_fx.screen_shake: shake scaled to damage; only noticeable on heavy hits

audio_notes.sfx: hits/bounces/explosions timed to event log; pitch rises with damage; royalty-free only
audio_notes.music: OPTIONAL toggle, not a default. Keep volume low and duck under narration. A/B test with vs without.
audio_notes.narration: primary audio; must stay clear and on top of the mix
